name: Archangel Anthius
description: An Archangel who told the Keepers of the Faith that fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith.

description_citations.text: Chronicles: card flavor text (Chronicles, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Archangel Anthius speaks to the Keepers of the Faith of the Sword of Faith.
timeline.quote: And then the Archangel Anthius spoke to them, saying, "Fear shall be vanquished by the Sword of Faith."
